description: Source code for managing cgroup files, including functions to open, read, write, and verify cgroup files, with support for different kernel versions and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: OpenFile
methods.description: Opens a cgroup file in a specified directory with given flags, ensuring it is a cgroup file.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads data from a cgroup file in a specified directory.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Writes data to a cgroup file in a specified directory.

methods.name: WriteFileByLine
methods.description: Writes data to a cgroup file line by line if data contains newlines.

methods.name: prepareOpenat2
methods.description: Prepares the environment for openat2 system call, with fallback support.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Internal function to open a file with support for cgroup v2 and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: openAndCheck
methods.description: Fallback method to open and verify a file is a cgroup file when openat2 is unavailable.
